name: Akagawa Jirou no Yuurei Ressha
source:
Based on the detective story Ghost Train, the first one written by the popular Japanese author Akagawa Jirō. You play a young detective who investigates a strange case: eight people have disappeared, and rumors are heard about a mysterious Ghost Train. You head to a remote village to learn more about those events.

[from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/nes/akagawa-jir-no-yrei-ressha]MobyGames[/url]]
